tasks.short: Examine whether the accounting method complies.

steps.what: List the statutory provisions cited for the method.
Examine the accounting records and the method used.
Determine whether the method is in compliance.

tasks.design: Statutory provisions already cited for the accounting method are listed from {DOCS}. The revenue agent examines the records and determines whether the method is appropriate and in compliance. A method with no provision id is not given a list. The list does not determine compliance.
tasks.previous_blocker: The agent re-read the statute for every system because the provision was not cited on the file.
tasks.enabler_now: A cited provision can be listed before the agent examines the records.
tasks.still_hard: A method the provision does not contemplate, and records that do not match the method described.
tasks.human_edge: The agent can see a cited provision that the records do not actually follow.
tasks.altitude: Cited provisions are open. The agent still examines the system and still determines compliance. An uncited provision is not treated as met.

reach.task: Open the cited provision and still judge whether the practice meets it.
reach.learn: The provision can be listed. The examination stays here.

evidence.claim: A statutory provision already cited can be listed. The list cannot determine that an accounting method complies.
The agent examines the records and determines compliance. A provision list is not that determination.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A revenue agent in a European tax office. National assessment rules apply. A list does not send a notice, issue a refund, or seize property.

Fields: Method id and provision id, produced by the method file. A method with no provision id is not given a list. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the revenue agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the statute texts the office already stores.
unknowns: Which provisions are cited this year.
research_questions: What share of methods cite a provision id?
Which examinations are always done by the agent?

already_counted.description: The agent still examines the records and the method.

incremental.description: The agent finds a provision the file did not cite.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing provisions already cited. It disappears when the method has no provision id and the agent searches the statute. Examining the records stays with the agent.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assemble the contested case file for the hearing.
Participate in the informal appeals hearing.
Note what the other agent asked the hearing to decide.

tasks.design: The contested case file is assembled in {DOCS} before the hearing. The revenue agent participates in the informal appeals hearing on a case from another agent. The pack does not speak at the hearing. A case with no id is not packed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The hearing started while the agent was still looking for the other agent’s note.
tasks.enabler_now: The contested file can be assembled before the hearing.
tasks.still_hard: A point raised in the room that is not in the pack.
tasks.human_edge: The agent can hear that the pack does not contain the dispute.
tasks.altitude: The pack can be ready. The agent still sits the hearing and still notes what was asked. The pack is not the hearing.

reach.task: Bring the file to a contested hearing and still take part.
reach.learn: The file can be assembled. The hearing stays here.

evidence.claim: A contested case file can be assembled before a hearing. The pack cannot participate in the hearing.
The hearing stays with the agent. A pack is not an appeal decision.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A revenue agent in a European tax office. National assessment rules apply. A list does not send a notice, issue a refund, or seize property.
Fields: Case id, produced by the contested file. A case with no id is not packed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the revenue agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the case store the office already keeps.
research_questions: What share of contested cases are complete before the hearing?
Which hearings the agent always attends?

already_counted.description: The agent still participates in the hearing.
The agent still notes what was asked.

incremental.description: The agent adds a paper the pack did not contain.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is assembling the contested file. It disappears when the case id is missing and the agent hunts for the papers. Participating in the hearing stays with the agent.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare the court brief and seize records.

steps.what: List the records already indexed for the court case.
Prepare the brief and the charges for court.
Keep searching and seizing the records with the agent.

tasks.design: Records already indexed for the court case are listed from {DOCS}. The revenue agent prepares the brief and the charges and assists in searching and seizing the records the warrant names. The index does not seize anything. A record with no case id is not listed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Briefs cited a record nobody could find in the index, and the search started from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: Indexed records can be listed before the agent writes the brief.
tasks.still_hard: A record the index does not name, and a search the warrant does not allow.
tasks.human_edge: The agent can see an indexed record that the warrant does not cover.
tasks.altitude: The index is open before the brief. The agent still prepares the charges and still searches and seizes. The index is not a seizure.

reach.task: Use an index to prepare and still carry out the search in person.
reach.learn: The index can be listed. The seizure stays here.

evidence.claim: Indexed records can be listed for a brief. The index cannot search or seize records.
EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with legal effect, and a determining score counts. The agent accepts the version before a notice or a refund goes out.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A revenue agent in a European tax office. National assessment rules apply. A list does not send a notice, issue a refund, or seize property.
Fields: Case id and record id, produced by the case index. A record with no case id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the revenue agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the index the office already keeps. A warrant is required before any seizure, and the agent carries it out.
unknowns: Who drafts the charge with the agent.
Which records a warrant may name.
research_questions: What share of court records are already indexed?
Which searches are always done by the agent?

already_counted.description: The agent still prepares the brief and the charges.
The agent still searches and seizes the records.

incremental.description: The agent adds a record the index did not name.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing records already indexed. It disappears when the record has no case id and the agent searches the papers. Preparing the brief and seizing records stay with the agent.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Enter fielded return information into the processing file.
Read a paper return line only when the total ties.

loop.purpose: Read a printed amount only when the recomputed total matches the stated total.
loop.input: Paper return lines and the stated total.
loop.output: Tied lines, or a stopped return.
loop.check: The recomputed total equals the stated total and each line has an id.
loop.stop: A return whose total does not match is left unread.
loop.why_not_simpler: The paper return is not a set of fields. A template cannot read the printed amount. The loop stops when the total does not match, and the agent enters that return.

steps.what: Enter the return lines the tie-out left behind.

tasks.design: Fielded return information is entered in the {ERP} for processing when the line ids are already present. A paper return is read only when the recomputed total ties to the stated total. The revenue agent enters the lines the tie-out left behind. A return that does not tie is not passed into processing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Returns were keyed from paper, and a total that did not match was still processed.
tasks.enabler_now: A fielded return can be entered, and a paper total can be checked before keying.
tasks.still_hard: A paper return whose total does not tie, and a line the form does not identify.
tasks.human_edge: The agent can see a tied total on a return that is still the wrong taxpayer.
tasks.altitude: Fielded returns are entered. The agent still enters the paper returns that do not tie. A mismatch is not processed.

reach.task: Import a fielded file and stop when the total does not tie.
reach.learn: The import can run. The stopped return stays with the agent.

evidence.claim: A return that is already fielded can be entered for processing. A paper total that does not tie cannot be passed.
A recomputed total that does not tie to the source figures stops. The agent reviews the mismatch. The check does not change the figure.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A revenue agent in a European tax office. National assessment rules apply. A list does not send a notice, issue a refund, or seize property.

Fields: Line id and stated total, produced by the return. A paper return whose recomputed total does not match is not entered by the read. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the revenue agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the processing file the office already keeps.
unknowns: What share of returns arrive already fielded.
Who may release a stopped return.
research_questions: What share of returns are already fielded?
Which stopped returns the agent always enters?

already_counted.description: The agent still enters the returns the tie-out left behind.

incremental.description: The agent keys a line the paper read could not identify.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is entering returns that are already fielded and paper lines whose total already ties. It disappears when the total does not match and the agent enters the return. A mismatch is not processed. The range is not taken from a vendor time claim.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The agent still examines the accounting method, still sits the hearing, and still seizes records under a warrant. A fielded return can be entered before the agent looks at the lines that do not tie.
reach: Financial quantitative analysts import a fielded file and stop when a total does not tie, and this job learns the same stop on a paper return.
Government property inspectors search under a warrant themselves, and this job learns a record index is not a seizure.
skills_to_grow: Enter a paper line only when the total ties, and leave the rest with the agent.
Keep the hearing and the seizure with the agent.
role.ambitious_version: Fielded returns are entered before the agent reviews the lines that do not tie, and hearings and seizures are still done by that person.
